entries.name: MAILCHIMP_API_KEY
entries.description: A Mailchimp API key for the store's account, ending in its data center (for example -us21). Mailchimp keys can't be limited to reading, so the connector sends only its five listed GET reads.
howToGet: Sign in to Mailchimp as an account owner or admin, open Profile > Extras > API keys, and choose Create A Key. Name it KaratOS.
Copy the key straight into the host's secret store. Mailchimp shows it once. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
To cut KaratOS off, delete the key on the same page.

entries.name: MAILCHIMP_WEBHOOK_SECRET
entries.description: A random secret the instance adds to its Mailchimp webhook URL as ?key=, since Mailchimp doesn't sign deliveries. Only needed once webhooks are turned on; the scheduled sync works without it.
howToGet: Let npm run secrets:setup generate it, or make 32 random bytes as hex.
Register the webhook in the audience's Settings > Webhooks with the instance's URL ending in ?key= and this value.
